subject: MAP launch: safeguards + SOC 2 evidence owners (kickoff)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ames <j.ames@emeraldhealth.com>, Leah Park <l.park@emeraldhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP launch: safeguards + SOC 2 evidence owners (kickoff)

Hi Jordan / Leah —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I’m starting a brief mutual action plan (MAP) thread to align on security/compliance owners and the evaluation cadence so we can keep your SOC 2 readiness and our POC timeline synchronized. I’ve attached a first-draft MAP and an evidence roster to make assignments explicit.

High-level objectives for this kickoff:
- Lock stakeholder points of contact for GRC, engineering, and legal by EOW (Fri 6/11).
- Confirm evidence owners for the initial SOC 2 control families (Access, Change Mgmt, Logging) by next Tuesday (6/15).
- Define the Redwood evaluation plan scope: data handling review + inference privacy evaluation + perf baseline for the chosen model family.

Proposed owners from our side:
- GRC lead: Priyom Das (CC’d) — SOC 2 evidence intake, control walk-throughs.
- Technical liaison: Marcus Lin (CC’d) — infra/data flow, log/export artifacts.
- Account lead: Lauren Bishop (CC’d) — commercial coordination and procurement handoffs.

Jordan / Leah — can you confirm Emerald Health’s POC stakeholders for Security, Privacy, and Procurement so we can populate the MAP? If you’d like, we can run a focused 30-minute intake call the week of 6/14 to walk the roster and evidence checklist.

Next steps (my ask):
1) Reply with names/emails for Emerald Health owners.
2) Review the attached MAP and mark any timeline conflicts.
3) Tell us if you prefer weekly syncs or a shared issue tracker for evidence items (we can use a shared Drive + tag owners).

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Emerald_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_Evidence_Roster.csv (csv), Data_Flow_Diagram.png (png)
From: Jordan Ames <j.ames@emeraldhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Park <l.park@emeraldhealth.com>, procurement@emeraldhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP launch: safeguards + SOC 2 evidence owners (kickoff)

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear outline. Quick answers from Emerald:
- Security lead: Jordan Ames (me) — security@emeraldhealth.com
- Privacy/data: Leah Park (CTO) — l.park@emeraldhealth.com
- Procurement contact: procurement@emeraldhealth.com (cc’d)

We prefer a weekly 30-minute sync on Tuesdays; that cadence works for our internal reviewers. We’ll review the MAP and return suggested owner changes by tomorrow.

Can you clarify whether Redwood will share exportable logs for the POC or whether we need to request specific artifacts? Our compliance team will want the exact list so they can map to controls.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ames
Head of Security Operations
Emerald Health
security@emeraldhealth.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ames <j.ames@emeraldhealth.com>, Leah Park <l.park@emeraldhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP launch: safeguards + SOC 2 evidence owners (kickoff)

Jordan / Leah —

Thanks for confirming owners. To answer your question about artifacts: Redwood will provide a defined evidence package for the POC that includes:
- Token-level request/response logging (redacted per config)
- System access lists and IAM role snapshots
- Deployment/configuration manifests and change history
- Application and infra-level logs (rotation policy + retention)
- KV cache and cache-invalidation notes where relevant

For SOC 2 mapping we’ll export CSVs and a folder of redacted logs where possible. Marcus will scope exact log locations and export formats. Priyom (me) will own the evidence delivery schedule and gap mapping.

Proposed timeline (compressed for POC):
- 6/11: Confirm Emerald owners (you did — thanks).
- 6/15: Redwood delivers initial evidence roster mapped to control families.
- 6/22: Evidence artifacts exported + first control walkthrough (30–45m).
- 7/02: Finalize any outstanding evidence items and escalate exceptions if needed.

If Emerald’s compliance team needs a different cadence, share preferred dates.

Action items for Emerald: please add any required artifact types we missed (e.g., specific audit trail formats) and confirm Tuesday 6/15 for the initial roster delivery review.

—
Priyom Das
GRC Program Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ames <j.ames@emeraldhealth.com>, Leah Park <l.park@emeraldhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP launch: safeguards + SOC 2 evidence owners (kickoff)

Jordan / Leah —

Looping in a few technical clarifications ahead of the evidence export:
- Logs: we’ll deliver structured logs in JSON/CSV with the following fields: timestamp, request_id, model_variant, latency_ms, token_count, redaction_flag. We can increase redaction per field if Emerald requires.
- Data flow: attached a PNG showing where inference request payloads transit (redacted PII path). If you need raw traces for a short window, we can coordinate a secure transfer to your SFTP.
- Evaluation plan: for the POC we’ll run a test set of 200 prompts you provide + 100 adversarial prompts centered on PHI/PII handling. We’ll produce a short report: safety flags, leakage hits, and performance numbers.

I’ll prepare the log export spec and share it by EOD Tuesday (6/15).

—
Marcus Lin
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: Data_Flow_Diagram.png (see included diagram)
From: Leah Park <l.park@emeraldhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Ames <j.ames@emeraldhealth.com>, procurement@emeraldhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP launch: safeguards + SOC 2 evidence owners (kickoff)

Thanks — this looks good and actionable. A couple quick clarifications from Emerald:
- We’ll provide the 200 prompt test set by EOB 6/16.
- For logs, we need assurance that any PHI/PII is redacted before leaving Redwood’s environment; where redaction is not possible we’ll request short-lived secure transfer with encryption at rest and in transit.
- Procurement wants an estimated timeline for contract signature — can we target a signature date of 7/15 contingent on POC results? We’ll loop in our procurement lead if that’s acceptable.

Confirming Tuesday weekly cadence starting 6/22 is fine (for your team’s calendar). Appreciate the plain-language MAP.

Leah Park
CTO, Emerald Health
l.park@emeraldhealth.com
On Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:00:00 -0700 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:

>

>
> — Soojin
